abstract: Climate policies often increase electricity prices by more than they increase prices of fossil fuels. Using administrative data on German manufacturing plants from 2009 to 2017, we provide evidence that these price changes induce plants to generate electricity onsite using fossil fuels. Not all manufacturing plants are subject to emissions pricing under the EU’s Emissions Trading System, and we find evidence of emissions leakage: Electricity generation shifts from regulated power plants to unregulated manufacturing plants.

title: Detection of Collusive Networks in Multistage Auctions
title_zh: 多阶段拍卖中共谋网络的检测
authors: Baránek, Bruno, Musolff, Leon, Titl, Vítězslav
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We develop a method for detecting cartels in multistage auctions. Our approach allows firms to act collusively against cartel members yet competitively otherwise. In these auctions, bidders submit initial bids and can later revise them downward. As initial bids are shaded, close initial bids indicate similar costs and thus create strong incentives to undercut rivals. We classify firm pairs as collusive if they ignore this incentive by failing to update bids against each other, relative to other pairs with similarly close initial bids. Our algorithm predicts Ukraine’s Antimonopoly Committee sanctions: classified pairs are nine times more likely to be sanctioned.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种在多阶段拍卖中检测卡特尔的方法。该方法允许企业在针对卡特尔成员时采取合谋行为，而在其他情况下则保持竞争。在这类拍卖中，竞标者提交初始报价，随后可向下调整报价。由于初始报价存在折价，相近的初始报价表明成本相似，从而产生强烈的降价竞争动机。我们将那些相对于其他初始报价相近的配对而言，未能针对彼此更新报价、从而忽视这一动机的企业配对判定为合谋。我们的算法预测了乌克兰反垄断委员会的制裁结果：被判定为合谋的配对受到制裁的可能性是其他配对的九倍。

title: Endogenous Tracking: Sorting and Peer Effects

authors: Chernulich, Aleksei, Gauriot, Romain, Min, Daehong
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Can an educational system without ability tracking and signalling motive generate self-sorting of students by ability? We build a theoretical model to show that when seeking positive peer effects is combined with costly educational choices, even in the absence of exogenous requirements on achievements used in standard tracking systems, high-achieving students self-sort by choosing costly courses, which we refer to as endogenous tracking. We use data from French middle schools, where students were grouped together based on their choices between Spanish and effort-costly German language classes, to show that costly language class choices lead to sorting and to identify peer effects.
abstract_zh: 一个缺乏能力分层和信号动机的教育体系，能否促使学生按能力进行自我分类？我们构建了一个理论模型，表明当追求正向同伴效应与高成本教育选择相结合时，即使没有标准分层体系中对学业成绩的外生要求，高成就学生也会通过选择高成本课程实现自我分类——我们将此称为内生分层。我们利用法国初中数据（学生根据西班牙语与高努力成本的德语课程选择进行分组）证明，高成本语言课程选择会导致分层现象，并识别出同伴效应。

abstract: This article introduces the evidence and associated modeling frameworks contemporary economists use to understand the effects of trade and trade policy on labor markets, with a particular emphasis on labor-market frictions and adjustment dynamics. The effects of trade shocks differ across industries, regions, and occupations, implying the presence of important adjustment frictions in labor markets, and these effects evolve slowly over time, implying the need for dynamic frameworks rationalizing slow transitions. After reviewing the key insights from this literature, we discuss policies aimed at mitigating costs to workers and ensuring that the gains from trade are shared more equitably.

abstract: This paper presents an updated version of the Laeven and Valencia (2013, 2020) database on systemic banking crises, extending the coverage through 2025. The update incorporates new episodes, while maintaining the definition established in previous editions, which emphasizes both significant signs of financial distress and substantial policy interventions. The update integrates textual tools to screen potential candidates that are then further scrutinized to confirm if our definition is met. The database includes information on banking crises episodes during 1970-2025, including starting dates, policy responses, fiscal costs, and output losses. It offers a comprehensive tool for assessing cross-country vulnerabilities and policies to resolve banking crises.

title: Decentralization, Service Delivery, and Legitimacy: The Case of Mali
title_zh: 分权、服务提供与合法性：以马里为例
authors: Mertens, Gaetan, Touré, Nouhoum
official: 官方在线 2026-06-18 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: In fragile, conflict-affected, and violent contexts, decentralization is widely promoted to improve service delivery and strengthen the social contract by shifting power closer to citizens. However, empirical evidence on whether these reforms deliver in environments marked by weak state capacity and low institutional trust remains limited. This paper evaluates Mali’s Project for the Deployment of State Resources for the Improvement of Services program, which implemented performance-based conditional grants across 102 communes between 2021 and 2024. Drawing on administrative budget data and georeferenced Afrobarometer survey data, the study assesses the impacts of performance-based conditional grants on local fiscal performance, service delivery, and institutional legitimacy. The results show that a 1 percent increase in performance-based conditional grant allocations is associated with a 1.2 percent increase in investment expenditures and measurable improvements in budget balances. Expenditures were reallocated toward social sectors (education, health, water, and agriculture), consistent with program objectives. A difference-in-differences analysis points to statistically significant increases in citizen satisfaction with public services, particularly health (+2.6 percentage points), water and sanitation (+1.4), and education (+1.0), as well as an 18.4-point rise in trust in municipal counc ils. Institutional “spillover” effects extended to the national level, with trust in the presidency and parliament increasing by 9.1 and 7.3 points, respectively. A scenario-based cost-effectiveness analysis points to potentially substantial returns under the stated assumptions. Illustrative estimates suggest that observed trust gains could be associated with USD 57 million to USD 141 million in additional annual tax revenues, equivalent to 1.1 to 2.8 times the program’s total cost, through enhanced voluntary compliance—assuming a transmission of trust into compliance broadly consistent with parameters in the literature. These findings are consistent with the view that well-designed performance-based transfers may improve service outcomes and contribute to rebuilding public trust in fragile, conflict-affected, and violent contexts, with effects that appear to extend beyond the local level. Policy implications include considering institutionalization of the performance-based conditional grants within Mali’s fiscal architecture and the design of a medium-term roadmap for sustainability and possible scale-up.
abstract_zh: 在脆弱、受冲突影响和暴力环境中，权力下放被广泛推广，旨在通过将权力下放至公民层面来改善公共服务并强化社会契约。然而，关于此类改革在政府能力薄弱、制度信任度低的环境中是否有效的实证证据仍然有限。本文评估了马里2021至2024年间在102个市镇实施的"国家资源部署以改善服务项目"中的绩效导向有条件拨款计划。基于行政预算数据和地理参照的非洲晴雨表调查数据，本研究评估了绩效导向有条件拨款对地方财政绩效、公共服务供给及制度合法性的影响。结果显示：绩效导向有条件拨款每增加1%，投资支出相应增长1.2%，预算平衡状况出现可量化改善。支出向教育、卫生、水利和农业等社会领域重新配置，这与项目目标一致。双重差分分析表明，公民对公共服务的满意度出现统计显著提升，其中卫生服务满意度提高2.6个百分点、供水和卫生设施满意度提高1.4个百分点、教育满意度提高1.0个百分点，同时市镇议会信任度上升18.4个百分点。制度"溢出效应"延伸至国家层面，总统和议会信任度分别提升9.1和7.3个百分点。基于情景的成本效益分析显示，在既定假设条件下可能产生显著回报。估算表明，假设信任向税收遵从的传导效应与文献参数基本一致，观察到的信任提升可能通过增强自愿纳税遵从带来每年5700万至1.41亿美元的额外税收收入，相当于项目总成本的1.1至2.8倍。这些发现与以下观点一致：设计良好的绩效导向转移支付能够改善服务成效，并有助于在脆弱、受冲突影响和暴力环境中重建公众信任，其影响似乎超越地方层面。政策启示包括：考虑将绩效导向有条件拨款制度化纳入马里财政架构，并制定中期路线图以实现可持续发展和可能的规模扩展。

title: State Capacity as an Organizational Problem
title_zh: 组织能力作为一个组织问题
authors: Nicola Mastrorocco, Edoardo Teso
official: 官方在线 2026-06-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We investigate how technologies that reduce the costs of monitoring by central authorities have shaped the historical transition from small patrimonial states to large bureaucratic organizations. Our analysis is based on a novel dataset that traces changes in the organizational structure and geographic presence of the U.S. federal government over the nineteenth century. To identify causal effects, we develop a new identification strategy that exploits the expansion of the railroad network as a source of variation in the travel time–and thus monitoring costs–between Washington D.C. and other locations. We present three main findings. First, reductions in travel time to Washington D.C. significantly increased the likelihood of federal government presence in a location. Second, this effect is stronger for occupations and tasks characterized by more severe agency problems. Third, decreases in travel time to Washington D.C. are associated with a decline in patrimonial features of the federal government in the location, in line with enhanced monitoring capacity reducing dependence on personal trust and connections.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了中央机构降低监控成本的技术如何塑造了从小型世袭国家向大型官僚组织的历史转型。我们的分析基于一个新颖的数据集，该数据集追踪了19世纪美国联邦政府组织结构与地理分布的变化。为识别因果效应，我们开发了一种新的识别策略，利用铁路网络的扩张作为华盛顿特区与其他地点之间旅行时间（即监控成本）变化的来源。我们提出三项主要发现：第一，前往华盛顿特区旅行时间的缩短显著增加了联邦政府在某一地点设立机构的可能性；第二，这种效应在代理问题更严重的职业和任务中更为显著；第三，前往华盛顿特区旅行时间的减少与当地联邦政府世袭特征的减弱相关，这与监控能力增强减少了对个人信任和关系依赖的结论一致。

title: Water Works: Causes and Consequences of Safe Drinking Water in America
title_zh: 水之功效：美国安全饮用水的成因与影响
authors: Keiser, David A, Mazumder, Bhashkar, Molitor, David, Shapiro, Joseph S
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Since the 1974 Safe Drinking Water Act, the U.S. has spent \$2 trillion to provide safe drinking water, yet drinking water for 10--20 percent of Americans violates standards. We study trends, causes, and consequences of U.S. drinking water pollution, using 266 million readings on 1, 250 pollutants over decades that we obtained from 48 states via dozens of Freedom of Information Act and associated requests. We link pollution to administrative Medicare data on older Americans' health outcomes. Three findings emerge. First, U.S. drinking water pollution has declined rapidly; the share of readings exceeding current health standards fell by half from 2003--2019. Unregulated pollutants declined more slowly. Low-income areas have higher pollution; Black and Hispanic communities have more complex patterns. Second, loans provided by the Safe Drinking Water Act to water systems reduce pollution. At the estimated average loan cost-effectiveness, these loans could eliminate pollution above health standards for \$46 annually per person. Third, these loans reduce mortality rates of older Americans. Although fiscal federalism cautions against federal funding of local public goods with few inter-jurisdictional externalities like drinking water, we estimate large benefits from Safe Drinking Water Act loans.
abstract_zh: 自1974年《安全饮用水法》实施以来，美国已投入2万亿美元用于提供安全饮用水，但仍有10%至20%的美国民众的饮用水不符合标准。本研究通过《信息自由法》及相关申请，从48个州获取了数十年间涵盖1250种污染物的2.66亿条监测数据，系统分析了美国饮用水污染的趋势、成因及影响。我们将污染数据与老年人群的联邦医疗保险行政健康记录进行关联分析，得出三项发现：第一，美国饮用水污染水平快速下降，2003至2019年间超过现行健康标准的监测值比例下降了一半。未受监管的污染物下降速度较慢。低收入地区污染程度更高，非裔和拉丁裔社区的污染模式更为复杂。第二，《安全饮用水法》向供水系统提供的贷款有效降低了污染水平。按估算的平均贷款成本效益计算，这些贷款每年仅需人均46美元即可消除超标污染。第三，这些贷款降低了美国老年人口的死亡率。尽管财政联邦主义理论反对联邦政府资助像饮用水这类跨辖区外部性较弱的本地公共品，但本研究证实《安全饮用水法》贷款产生了显著的社会效益。

title: Learning in the Limit: Income Inference from Credit Extensions
title_zh: 极限学习：从信贷扩展中推断收入
authors: XIAO YIN

abstract: Combining a randomized controlled trial with administrative and survey data, this paper shows that credit limit extensions significantly increase total spending and income expectations. By controlling for changes in personal income expectations, the spending response to credit limit extensions weakens by approximately 30%. For financially unconstrained consumers, expectation changes account for around two‐thirds of the spending responses to limit extensions. These findings are consistent with consumers inferring future income from credit supply.
abstract_zh: 本文通过将随机对照试验与行政及调查数据相结合，发现信用额度提升显著增加了总支出和收入预期。在控制个人收入预期变化后，信用额度提升对支出的影响减弱约30%。对于财务不受约束的消费者而言，预期变化解释了约三分之二的额度提升支出反应。这些发现与消费者从信贷供给中推断未来收入的推论一致。

title: Financial Crisis and Macro-Prudential Policies
title_zh: 金融危机与宏观审慎政策
authors: Alessandro Rebucci, Gianluca Benigno, Christopher Otrok, Huigang Chen, Eric Young
official: 官方在线 2011-01-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Stochastic general equilibrium models of small open economies with occasionally binding financial frictions are capable of mimicking both the business cycles and the crisis events associated with the sudden stop in access to credit markets (Mendoza, 2010). In this paper we study the inefficiencies associated with borrowing decisions in a two-sector small open production economy. We find that this economy is much more likely to display "under-borrowing" rather than "over-borrowing" in normal times. As a result, macro-prudential policies (i.e. Tobin taxes or economy-wide controls on capital inflows) are costly in welfare terms in our economy. Moreover, we show that macro-prudential policies aimed at minimizing the probability of the crisis event might be welfare-reducing. Our analysis shows that there is a much larger scope for welfare gains from policy interventions during financial crises. That is to say that, within our modelling approach, ex post or crisis-management policies dominate ex ante or macro-prudential ones.
abstract_zh: 具有偶尔约束性金融摩擦的小型开放经济体的随机一般均衡模型，能够模拟与信贷市场准入突然停止相关的经济周期和危机事件（Mendoza, 2010）。本文研究了两部门小型开放生产经济中借贷决策相关的低效率问题。我们发现，在正常时期，该经济体更可能出现"借贷不足"而非"借贷过度"的现象。因此，宏观审慎政策（如托宾税或对资本流入的全面控制）在我们的经济体中会产生福利成本。此外，我们证明，旨在最小化危机事件发生概率的宏观审慎政策可能反而降低福利。我们的分析表明，在金融危机期间，政策干预带来的福利收益空间要大得多。也就是说，在我们的建模框架内，事后或危机管理政策优于事前或宏观审慎政策。
